transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a rental robotic palletizer available for installation in Bay 7 before next week's peak-season packaging run. The rental quotation covers the palletizer itself, installation support, and operator training, and Bay 7 has adequate access for delivery. Since I have authority to approve this rental, I'd like to move through our normal pre-deployment review today. Could maintenance, safety, quality, and production training each report their relevant requirements so we can get this approved and deployed in time?
